penta-eq.title: Drums that need crack and body
penta-eq.note: More crack and body on the snare, more snap in the kit - analog-matched curves.
penta-eq.source: Under My Skin - OnAir Music (kick, snare, break)

penta-eq.title: A verse that needs weight and air
penta-eq.note: Passive tube curves: the verse gets weight, presence and air.
penta-eq.source: Ronin - OnAir Music feat. KXNE (guest verse)

penta-eq.title: A clean piano that should sound sampled
penta-eq.note: A clean piano turned into a dusty sampler loop.

duo-compressor.title: A drum bus that should hit harder
duo-compressor.note: Parallel smash: the ghost notes and the room come up, the kit hits harder.
duo-compressor.source: Under My Skin - OnAir Music (kick, snare, break)

duo-compressor.title: A verse that jumps in level
duo-compressor.note: A steady, upfront rap vocal - every word at the same level.
duo-compressor.source: Ronin - OnAir Music feat. KXNE (guest verse)

duo-compressor.title: A thin piano that needs density
duo-compressor.note: Grit and squash: the piano gets thick, close and dusty.

gate.title: Drum tails that ring too long
gate.note: SHAPE cuts the drum tails short - no clicks, no kinks.
gate.source: Under My Skin - OnAir Music (kick, snare, break)

gate.title: Beat bleeding from the headphones
gate.note: Before: the beat leaking from headphones (simulated, -18 dB). After: BLEED REMOVAL with the beat on the side-chain.
gate.source: Ronin - OnAir Music feat. KXNE (guest verse)

gate.title: Chords that need a swung chop
gate.note: RHYTHM chops the chords on a swung grid with click-free edges.

dereverb.title: A boom bap verse in a boxy bedroom
dereverb.note: Before: the verse recorded in a small bedroom (modelled). After: the room out, the voice kept.

dereverb.title: A trap verse in a boxy bedroom
dereverb.note: Before: the verse in a small bedroom (modelled). After: the room out, the voice kept.
dereverb.source: Ronin - OnAir Music feat. KXNE (guest verse)

dereverb.title: A soul vocal in a boxy bedroom
dereverb.note: Before: a soul vocal in a small bedroom (modelled). After: dry and close, as if sung in a booth.
dereverb.source: Light Me On Fire - Admiral Bob (ccMixter)

velvet.title: Sharp esses from a harsh mic
velvet.note: The neural de-esser takes the sharp esses down by about 11 dB - the voice untouched.

velvet.title: Bright esses on a trap verse
velvet.note: Bright and smooth: the esses down by about 7 dB, warmth everywhere else.
velvet.source: Ronin - OnAir Music feat. KXNE (guest verse)

velvet.title: A clean piano that should sound warm and lo-fi
velvet.note: Saturated and warm - the lo-fi colour in one preset.

master.title: A boom bap mix that must be loud and clean
master.note: Before: the unmastered mix turned up to the same loudness - it clips. After: Master, clean.
master.source: Under My Skin - OnAir Music (all stems)

master.title: A trap mix that clips when pushed
master.note: Before: the mix turned up to the same loudness with no limiter - it clips. After: loud and clean.
master.source: Ronin - OnAir Music feat. KXNE (all stems)

master.title: A lo-fi beat that must stay soft when loud
master.note: Before: the beat turned up to the same loudness - it clips. After: Master keeps it soft and warm.

space.title: A dry kit with no room
space.note: A real live room around a dry kit.
space.source: Under My Skin - OnAir Music (kick, snare, break)

space.title: A dry verse that needs a plate
space.note: A vocal plate with ESS DUCK - no hissing tails.
space.source: Ronin - OnAir Music feat. KXNE (guest verse)

space.title: A soul vocal that needs a hall
space.note: A lush hall that blooms in the gaps between the lines.
space.source: Light Me On Fire - Admiral Bob (ccMixter)

forbidden-seal.title: Drums that need dirt and density
forbidden-seal.note: Saturation smash: the kit gets loud, dense and dirty.
forbidden-seal.source: Under My Skin - OnAir Music (kick, snare, break)

forbidden-seal.title: An 808 lost on small speakers
forbidden-seal.note: The 808 distorted so it cuts through on small speakers - the sub stays clean.

forbidden-seal.title: A clean piano that needs tube grit
forbidden-seal.note: Tube grit on a clean piano: the lo-fi colour from physics.

76.title: Drums that need the 1176 crush
76.note: The kit crushed the way the 1176 does it.
76.source: Under My Skin - OnAir Music (kick, snare, break)

76.title: A verse that must sit upfront
76.note: The 1176 pushed hard: every word upfront, the attitude kept.
76.source: Ronin - OnAir Music feat. KXNE (guest verse)

76.title: A soul vocal that needs all-buttons grit
76.note: All buttons in: the famous 1176 grit on a soul vocal.
76.source: Light Me On Fire - Admiral Bob (ccMixter)
